# World of ClaudeCraft（克劳德争霸） v0.36.0 Release Notes
**Release:** v0.36.0
**Date:** 2026-08-11
**Previous release:** v0.35.1
Version 0.36.0 is the class overhaul release. The long-running class-overhaul
integration branch lands, followed by a numbers-only retune that brings eight specs into
the 150 to 200 DPS band at 120 seconds in best-in-slot gear. Around it, PvP records
learned to count draws, battleground seats backfill from the queue, the frame-hitch
elimination campaign and a loading-time pass made the client measurably smoother, and the
